accepted.title: Bounded discrepancy forces bounded sign-rank
accepted.text: For every δ>0, is there an integer d(δ) such that every finite sign matrix A with disc(A)≥δ has sign-rank at most d(δ)? Sign-rank is the minimum rank of a real matrix with sign pattern A. Define disc(A)=min_μ max_{S,T}|∑_{(x,y)∈S×T}μ(x,y)A_xy|, where μ ranges over probability distributions on the entries and S×T over rectangles.

accepted.title: Constant randomized parity-tree size with superpolynomial deterministic size
accepted.text: A parity decision tree asks the parity of any subset of input coordinates at each internal node. PDTsize is its minimum number of leaves; RPDTsize is the minimum worst-case number of leaves in a distribution of such trees computing the function with pointwise error at most 1/3. Is there a family f_n:F₂^n→{0,1} with RPDTsize(f_n)=O(1) but PDTsize(f_n)=2^{Ω(n)}? If exponential separation is unavailable, can PDTsize(f_n) grow faster than every fixed power of n?

accepted.text: Does a family f_n:F₂^n→{0,1} exist with bounded-error randomized parity decision-tree depth O(1) while ||f_n||_A grows faster than every fixed power of n? accepted.title: Constant randomized communication outside polynomial equality-oracle communication
accepted.text: Is there a family F_n:{0,1}^n×{0,1}^n→{0,1} with public-coin bounded-error communication cost O(1), but whose deterministic communication cost with access to an equality oracle is not bounded by any polynomial in log n? An oracle call compares two arbitrary strings, one computed locally by each party, at unit cost; ordinary communicated bits also count. Error is at most 1/3 on each input.
